intent: Reproduce ten historical voice failures against current c14 production and repair only current defects or demonstrably stale fixtures, preserving playback, privacy and diagnostics assertions.

validation.scope: Six original target methods plus all eighteen VoiceSpeechBufferTest methods, using actual current VoiceSession, speech projection/buffer, trace, plugin and deferred implementation.
Three literal inputs extracted from VoicePlaybackFailureReportingTest, streaming and terminal, through actual Session/Plugin/Deferred implementation; producer boundary is a recorder.

validation.result: All five test files and production admission/session/buffer/trace/plugin are unchanged from c14 to ede; deferred wrapper is unchanged; only downstream PCM priming and a feedback comment changed.

diagnosis: All five affected test files still assumed the superseded four-word opening or supplied an incomplete streamed word. Current production intentionally starts a completed opening clause or eight complete words, with a bounded adaptive arrival fallback. The fixtures did not reach their playback operation.
changes: Use completed streamed clauses in playback, timing, supersession and fault-report fixtures. Preserve all numeric timing, stale callback, privacy origin, cancellation, cause, redaction and terminal/streaming assertions. No production changes.
limits: The host harness isolates unrelated diagnostic collection/projection and native/recognizer boundaries; it does not replace the full Robolectric issue-reporting tests.
No native synthesis, emulator acceptance, broad Gradle or current-head full-CI qualification is claimed. Root owns canonical integration and required CI.
